description: This Java source file defines a component class 'CodeGlobalInitializerStep' that initializes various code and code value data (such as address types, countries, financial instruments, etc.) for the Fineract system. It uses API services to create and update code values, and is annotated with Spring stereotypes for dependency injection and ordering.

classes.name: CodeGlobalInitializerStep
classes.description: A Spring component that initializes multiple code and code value entries for system configuration, leveraging injected API service dependencies. It implements methods to create and update code values based on predefined constants for various categories such as address types, countries, financial instruments, and more.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Main method invoked to set up all codes and code values during system initialization.

methods.name: createCodeValues
methods.description: Creates multiple code values for a given code ID using a list of names.

methods.name: updateCodeValues
methods.description: Updates existing code values to set them as inactive based on a list of names.

methods.name: createCodeNames
methods.description: Creates code entries for each predefined code name category.
